gaps.title: Complete closure requires every named issuer authority class
gaps.close_criteria: A complete bundle may contain multiple submissions for one gap and is eligible only when every authority class listed by the canonical contract is represented by a cryptographically valid submission. Within one gap, authority seats must use distinct trust-registry key IDs and distinct identity/organization pairs; one omnipotent key or identity cannot fill multiple seats. Partial bundles report missing classes and can never produce all_authority_owned_gaps_closed=true.

gaps.title: Final signed review roster and acceptance context are removal-resistant
gaps.close_criteria: Before an accepted complete bundle can close rows, every final signed review artifact must carry the same schema-v1 closure manifest. The manifest binds the ordered final reviewer roster and acceptance state, reviewed_at, decision_reference and limitations. Because each review artifact digest is already in the reviewer Ed25519 statement, removing, adding, replacing or reordering a final reviewer, or changing the final acceptance context after signatures, fails validation. This source control does not discover a review never admitted to the final roster; external governance and transparency remain authority gates.
